The Iridium Internship Program is a 12-week program dedicated to helping students develop new skills and learn from industry professionals. This summer, Iridium had 36 interns from 25 colleges and universities including Harvard University, Vanderbilt University, and the University of Virginia. Iridium internships aren’t just for engineering students. Iridium has a variety of internships…
